# HORUS 0.6.1
- Adds **Find more** to Concepts with at least three captioned and embedded images. - Learns from every hand-selected image in the Concept, combining meaning, visual structure, and caption similarity. - Searches across the complete archive and excludes images already assigned to the Concept. - Keeps all suggestions reviewable: select candidates and choose **Add to [Concept]**; HORUS never assigns them silently. - Preserves the compact HORUS interface and existing project, search, rating, and archive workflows.

# HORUS 0.6.0
- Replaces the custom web-view updater with the native Sparkle 2 update system. - Checks the signed GitHub release feed when HORUS opens and then hourly. - Adds a native **Check for Updates…** command to the HORUS application menu. - Cryptographically verifies every update before replacing the application. - Keeps all team archive data and authentication on the separate Hetzner service.
This is the one-time bootstrap release for the new updater. Existing team members must install 0.6.0 manually; later releases can be installed through Sparkle.
